records.text: Zionist opponents were emailing and calling people to seek cancellations of the Catholics for Catholics event because speakers who did not support Israel were given a stage.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: It is hard for me to express to you how much and how persistent and how despicable the attacks have been from Zionists. This is not an anti-Zionist conference. ... But because they are angry that people who do not principally support Israel are getting a stage, they're angry that there can be life for Carrie Prejean Bowler after she says, actually, no, Catholic doctrine does not teach that I'm supposed to subjugate myself to the whims of Israel. ... verification.notes: Public sources confirm organized criticism of the gala and calls for invited figures to withdraw, but no reliable source or primary record verifies Owens's broader account of persistent coordinated emails and calls, the number or identity of senders, or their asserted motive. The event itself proceeded.

records.text: Owens said Erika Kirk personally took credit for having Matt Walsh cancel his in-person appearance at a Catholic prayer event because Owens was attending.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: She personally took credit. ... For having Matt Walsh cancel his in-person appearance at the Catholic prayer event for Catholic for Catholics just because I was attending. ... That's a fact. That's not my organization. He transformed what was supposed to be his appearance into a video message instead because Erika (Erika Kirk) was upset that I was going to be present.

verification.notes: The primary recording directly verifies that Owens made this accusation. Public event materials list both Owens and Matt Walsh, while the event archive contains Walsh's recorded message, corroborating the changed appearance format. No independent evidence was found proving that Erika Kirk caused the change, so that portion remains an allegation rather than an established fact.
